title: Step 1
prompt: The accepted model is a single downward-pointing triangle with a long horizontal top edge and two diagonal edges meeting at the lower point. Reject if the paper is still an unfolded square or diamond.

title: Step 2
prompt: The accepted model is an upright kite or diamond shape with left and right outer points, a top point, a bottom point, and two narrow folded flaps meeting along the vertical center near the bottom. Reject the previous simple triangle shape.

title: Step 3
prompt: The accepted model is a diamond shape with a horizontal crease across the middle and two narrow upright folded flaps at the top center. Reject if the model is still the closed kite from the previous step with no clear horizontal middle crease.

title: Step 4
prompt: The accepted model has a large lower diamond, a horizontal middle crease, symmetric triangular flaps opened upward on the left and right, and a narrow vertical flap in the top center. Reject if the side flaps are still closed.

title: Step 5
prompt: The accepted model keeps the upper leaf-like flaps visible and has the large front triangular flap folded upward over the center, with its base across the middle and its point near the upper center. Reject if the front triangular flap has not been raised.

title: Step 6
prompt: The accepted model keeps the upper leaf-like flaps visible and has the large front section folded downward into a wide horizontal band across the middle, leaving a smaller centered triangle above the band and a large downward diamond below it. Reject the previous step where the large front triangle is still raised.

title: Step 7
prompt: The accepted model keeps the upper leaf-like flaps visible and has the lower diamond folded upward into a long shallow horizontal base. Reject the previous step if a large downward diamond still hangs below the middle band.
